name: DeepL
description: DeepL translates text and documents between languages and offers a Write Pro add-on for writing assistance, with individual, team and business plans.
features: API tab on the pricing page
strengths: Individual and Team plans list a 30-day free trial
limitations: The free version is capped (50,000 characters per month, 1 file translation per month, files up to 5 MB)
Monthly-billing prices and API prices are not stated on the page we read

free.details: A free version is listed with 50,000 characters per user per month, 1 file translation per month, 1 glossary, 1 saved translation and files up to 5 MB.

pricing.trial: Individual and Team show a 30-day free trial (Free for 30 days, cancel anytime). Business shows no free trial.

plans.name: Individual
plans.note: Pakistan view: $8.74 per month billed annually (USD). Germany view from an earlier check: EUR 7.49. Individual shows 300,000 characters and 3 file translations per month.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: Pakistan view: $28.74 per user per month billed annually (USD). Germany view from an earlier check: EUR 24.99. 1,000,000 characters per user per month.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Pakistan view: $57.49 per user per month billed annually (USD). Germany view from an earlier check: EUR 49.99. Unlimited characters under a fair-usage policy.

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in EUR with Germany selected and include VAT where the page says so; other countries may see different prices. Monthly-billing prices: not stated.

api.summary: API tab (Pakistan view, USD): Developer is free with a one-time 1M-character credit; Growth is $26.00 per month billed annually plus usage ($27.50 per extra 1,000,000 characters); Enterprise API is custom.

verification.notes: Product active. /en/pricing redirects to /en/pro. Translator tab, Annual view, shown in USD for a Pakistan visitor: Individual $8.74/month billed annually, Team $28.74 per user/month billed annually, Business $57.49 per user/month billed annually, Enterprise custom; Individual and Team show a 30-day free trial. An earlier check with Germany selected showed EUR 7.49 / 24.99 / 49.99, so prices differ by region. The Monthly view and the free consumer tier were not re-read.
